6. `tenantctl mail send --org-id org_acme_industries --template enterprise-welcome-v2 --to admin@acme.example --request REQ-2025-01842`
7. `tenantctl billing invoices create --org-id org_acme_industries --description 'Enterprise onboarding setup fee' --amount 2500.00 --currency USD --due-days 0`
8. `tenantctl onboarding status --org-id org_acme_industries --require schema,seed,billing,email,invoice --format table`
